projectMove.title: A+ Academy midweek ship check, then keep Arena moving
projectMove.body: Today's midweek ship check is the moment to review Miyuki's open Core 1 Troubleshooting pass and the Virtualization audit so the course is stable before you leave for the cruise. Overnight, Testarossa resumed Phase 23 of the Arena Battlegrounds remake on Sol Max after the usage reset; she will keep pulling the next phases on her own and report finishes through me.

tip.title: Do a dry-pack pass with the new Dockers duffel tonight
tip.body: You bought the 22-inch rolling Dockers duffel for this trip, so one quick layout of clothes, toiletries, and the boarding-pass PDF tonight will show whether everything fits before Saturday's Tallahassee bus. Keep the Carnival boarding group C02 details and the Cozumel shore day in mind while you pack so day-three clothes are easy to grab.

extras.cruiseNote: The trip runs October 31 to November 5. The Tallahassee bus leaves Saturday night, October 31, the ship sails from Tampa on November 1 with an 11:00 to 11:30 AM arrival and boarding group C02, and Cozumel on November 3 (about 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM) is the one shore day.
extras.weatherNote: Mostly clear and mild this morning near 63F, warming to a high near 81F with almost no chance of rain.

surprise.title: Jazzmatazz at Blue Tavern, 8 to 11 PM
surprise.body: Your calendar holds Russian study from 6 to 8 tonight, so the early Halloween shows collide with it, but this one starts right as you close the books. Blues-rooted vocalist Samantha Carston sings with the Michael Bakan Trio at Blue Tavern, 1206 N Monroe St, from 8 to 11 PM, with a $10 cover. The forecast is dry and overcast, about 73°F at 8 PM and 71°F by 10, so it is an easy night out. One quiet jazz evening before the bus, and two days to sailing.
